about: LIN-3182: hand-coded catalogue of process changes since June 2026 in LinearViewer (LV) and simple-dispatcher (SD). Read by scripts/survey-landing-history.mjs. Grounded at LV cce25f13 and SD 3366748 (origin/main, 2026-10-01). 'measuredBefore'/'measuredAfter': was a number taken on the thing the change targeted, recorded before it landed / read after it landed. 'yes' = a designed read; 'partial' = a read that was too small to conclude, or a retrospective paper written later for another question; 'no' = none found. 'finished': 'half-finished' when a flag, old path, open follow-up or unconcluded experiment tied to the change remains at HEAD or open in the tracker; 'unclear' when the designed read is not yet due. Residue entries with 'grep' are re-checked at HEAD; with 'ticket' are re-checked against the tracker snapshot. retirementCondition is the change's own stated condition for retiring what it adds, if any.

changes.name: Class check in bug and review prompts
changes.problem: Fixes patched the one witness rather than the class of fault it belonged to (LIN-313: 'widen the model, don't patch the witness').

measuredBefore.evidence: LIN-313 description gives no rate

measuredAfter.evidence: docs/papers/harbour/which-rules-pay.md@cce25f13:188 (retrospective, 30 Sep: led 19 production changes, 12 real faults, in the last 100 Done tickets)

changes.name: GitHub main-protection ruleset: merge only on a passing CI success check
changes.problem: Merges to main were not mechanically gated on CI.

measuredBefore.evidence: no ticket found; date from the ruleset (docs/papers/harbour/steady-base-check.md@cce25f13:76-80)

measuredAfter.evidence: docs/papers/harbour/reliability-baseline.md (retrospective: main red on about 1% of pushes)

changes.note: simple-dispatcher has no equivalent protection (docs/papers/harbour/measuring-throughput.md@cce25f13 Findings).

changes.name: Autopilot stepper: drip-feed a task's beats into one held session
changes.problem: One-shot worker prompts produced lower-quality output than a supervisor that decomposes a task into beats and judges each (LIN-791, graduating the LIN-788 experiment).

measuredBefore.evidence: LIN-788 (prompt-only experiment, judged qualitatively: 'higher-quality output'), no number

measuredAfter.evidence: docs/papers/harbour/what-doubled-the-dispatches.md@cce25f13:121-123 (retrospective: 544 of 595 beats into worker sessions are stepper beats)

residue.what: Compact at the beat boundary (64% of one measured leg), open
Stepper recap channel is lossy, open

changes.name: Close-out step with review ledger, ledger discharge and CI-green-on-exact-commit
changes.problem: Merging and closing a ticket had no step that checked every review finding was dealt with (LIN-550).

measuredBefore.evidence: LIN-550 gives no rate

measuredAfter.evidence: docs/papers/harbour/which-rules-pay.md@cce25f13:191-193 (ledger 4 production changes, ledger-discharge 2); docs/papers/harbour/why-legs-repeat.md (repeated close-outs changed nothing, 20 of 20)

changes.note: LIN-810 relaxed the missing-ledger block the same day. 'Merge and Done need a recorded Approve and a discharged ledger' is enforced by prose only (docs/steady-base.md@cce25f13:51).

changes.name: Push-based wakes: subscribed parents are woken by a child's terminal feedback
changes.problem: Coordinating sessions polled their children; replace the up-chain poll with a reliable follow-up (LIN-826).

measuredBefore.evidence: LIN-826 gives no rate

measuredAfter.evidence: docs/papers/harbour/wake-inventory.md (retrospective: wakes 29% of tokens, 35% relayed re-arms)

changes.name: Arm-by-default completion hold: every stop except PENDING-internal is held for a follow-up
changes.problem: Stepper drip-feed latency: a session had to be relaunched for each beat unless it was held (LIN-906, reversing LIN-795).

measuredBefore.evidence: LIN-906 gives no rate

measuredAfter.evidence: docs/papers/harbour/where-the-effort-goes.md (retrospective: the rise in dispatches per ticket is warm beats into held sessions)

changes.name: Proportional ledger lane for low-risk changes, then widened
changes.problem: The review/close-out ledger was as strict for a low-risk change as for a risky one (LIN-898); human sign-off was demanded for items unprovable before merge (LIN-1579).

measuredBefore.evidence: LIN-898 cites one example ticket (LIN-872), no rate

measuredAfter.evidence: docs/papers/harbour/proportional-process-backtest.md (retrospective: at a fixed diff size light work takes about the same dispatches; the process is not lighter on it today)

changes.name: A DONE session is not held: it finalizes and its window closes; a later follow-up resumes it cold
changes.problem: DONE sessions never closed: a 60-minute completion-grace hold parked them, and the closeOnDone marker was never set (LIN-1219, LIN-1100).

measuredBefore.evidence: LIN-1219 describes the bug, gives no rate

measuredAfter.evidence: docs/papers/harbour/survey-check-4.md@cce25f13:177-181 (retrospective: cold resumes of finished sessions 0.2 to 2.6 per correct change)

residue.what: SD_CLOSE_WINDOW_ON_DONE, the LIN-1100 instant-rollback switch, still read at HEAD (default on)

changes.rollback: SD_CLOSE_WINDOW_ON_DONE=0 'leaves every window open exactly as before' (config.js@3366748:1110-1116)

changes.name: Stop-hook block cap 9 to 1000, and a re-fire for silent sessions
changes.problem: Claude Code force-ended long sessions after nine consecutive Stop-hook blocks, and sessions stalled silently after close-out (LIN-1266, LIN-1280).

measuredBefore.evidence: incident-driven

measuredAfter.evidence: docs/papers/harbour/what-doubled-the-dispatches.md@cce25f13:105 (retrospective: stall re-fires near one per correct change throughout)

changes.name: Sessions run at the dispatch's tier (the routing switch)
changes.problem: Harbour forwarded a model per dispatch but the claude-code harness ignored it, so every session ran at the account default (LIN-1285).

measuredBefore.evidence: LIN-1285 gives no cost or quality baseline; the planned study (LIN-1628, 'baseline cost per verified task, flip P0.4 on, read after one cycle') was never run

measuredAfter.evidence: docs/papers/harbour/model-choice.md@cce25f13:44-62 and docs/papers/harbour/why-throughput-halved.md (retrospective, 30 Sep)

residue.what: Blended-routing before/after study, never run

changes.name: A terminal wake for every distinct stepper beat, not only the first on each edge
changes.problem: A held stepper child was not re-invoked by its worker's terminal [done] and stalled ~31 minutes: a lost up-chain wake (LIN-1357); concurrent feedback was dropped (LIN-1343).

measuredBefore.evidence: LIN-1357: 'Single observed occurrence'

measuredAfter.evidence: docs/papers/harbour/what-doubled-the-dispatches.md@cce25f13:107 (retrospective: follow-ups per held session 4.7 to 7.4)

changes.name: Dispatch presets per kind, then harness-first routing

measuredBefore.evidence: none found

measuredAfter.evidence: docs/papers/harbour/what-doubled-the-dispatches.md@cce25f13:108 ('no count mechanism found')

changes.note: The preset values live in runtime config, not code (model-choice.md@cce25f13:49-51), so later routing moves left no commit.

changes.name: Routing moves made in runtime config: close-out back to frontier (~20 Jul), plan to mid (28 Jul), review and close-out effort high to medium (11 Sep)
changes.problem: Tuning which tier and effort each kind runs at (model-choice.md@cce25f13:56-61; model-effort-routing proposal of 2026-09-11).

measuredBefore.evidence: the 11 Sep effort move cites the routing proposal's census; the July moves cite nothing found

measuredAfter.evidence: docs/papers/harbour/model-choice.md@cce25f13:56-61 (dated afterwards from run-log prompt lengths)

changes.name: The plan-review leg: a gate between plan and implementation, with a one-cycle loop bound
changes.problem: The follow-on task ratio: missed siblings caught at code review each cost a full new arc; verify the plan's grounding before code exists (LIN-1600).

measuredBefore.evidence: LIN-1655 recorded the follow-on-ratio baseline before LIN-1603 merged; the instrument flagged it sufficient:false at n=30 (scripts/prompt-template-change-log.md@cce25f13:13-17)

measuredAfter.evidence: the designed after-read LIN-1661 could not run on the substrate (LIN-1875, 3 Aug), was deferred (29 Aug), released (4 Sep) and canceled on 12 Sep ('the measurement follows the change'); retrospective: docs/papers/harbour/review-loops.md@cce25f13:14 (11 of 94 approved first time)

residue.what: The designed after-read was canceled, never run
Follow-on-ratio metric definition decisions, open
The one-cycle loop bound is prose; John ruled on 25 Sep not to enforce it mechanically
